dataset_role: Fresh A2 series, separate from every historical A3 measurement; no sample pooling.
normalization: Raw reports and descriptive per-engine statistics; the A3-only normalizer was not used.
version_scope: Timing payload versions are retained per correctness record; other diagnostic compiler context is bound separately.
report_scope: Per-engine ranges summarize all exported rows. They are not whole-device utilization or common-clock phases; exported ratios and times retain independent normalization.

capture_contract.paired_timing: Three independent exact-selector BasicInfo captures per specialization, rotating capture order, warmup3,launch_count1,kernel replay; all raw samples retained.
capture_contract.diagnostics: One independent PipeUtilization capture per specialization and one ResourceConflictRatio capture per matrix specialization; warmup3,launch_count1,kernel replay. All rows retained separately from timing.
capture_contract.calibration: Five additional size points each have separate correctness and selector discovery, followed by one BasicInfo capture with three matching launch samples, warmup3,launch_count3,kernel replay,application iterations3. These are not independent process captures. The middle copy and matrix points use the separately declared paired timing samples.
capture_contract.shared_baseline: Direct affine specialization is the baseline for copy and known identity-index gather; no historical A3 samples are pooled.
capture_contract.cache: Each capture reuses its inputs for warmup/replay. Physical traffic, cache residence, and whole-process allocation are not measured.

collection_scope: One A2 product/device series. Timing, diagnostic and per-size calibration captures remain separately identified; no cross-product samples are pooled.
compiler_binding_scope: All five ordinary binaries in this series match the corresponding new A2 debug captures. Historical A3 compiler evidence is a different product/binary series.
